body:
It can be tricky to build a brand new Instagram account, particularly if you don’t have any followers.

In a world with millions of creators and businesses vying for attention, visibility can be a time-consuming process that requires continuous hard work. By using quality content combined with strategic posting and an SMM panel, one can boost growth. An SMM panel can complement social proof and boost content visibility when applied correctly, and organic marketing can drive authentic engagement.

SMMGen is here to let you know How to Grow a Brand New Instagram Account from 0 to 10K in 60 Days Using SMM Panel!

If you’re looking for Instagram-specific services, check our [Instagram SMM Panel](/instagram-smm-panel) for followers, views, and engagement.

## Is it Possible to Get 10K Followers in 60 Days?

Yes, but it’s not magic; there are several things that need to happen to be successful.

These include:

- Content quality
- Posting consistency
- Niche selection
- Audience demand
- Engagement strategy
- Effective use of promotional media/techniques

Simply having an SMM panel won’t help you succeed. First, make sure you understand [are SMM panels safe](/blog/are-smm-panels-safe) and how to use them properly as part of a broader Instagram development plan.

## Step 1: Select a Clear Niche

Determine who your target audience is before posting. Popular Instagram niches:

- Fashion
- Fitness
- Travel
- Business
- Technology
- Food
- Education
- Entertainment

People with a clear niche tend to have a faster-growing account because Instagram knows who to target with the content.

Learn [how to increase followers on Instagram organically and safely](/blog/how-to-increase-followers-on-instagram-organically-and-safely) to build a strong foundation in your chosen niche.

## Step 2: Optimize Your Profile for First Impressions

Showing a professional profile makes a great first impression.

Make sure you have:

- A clear profile picture
- Keyword-rich username
- Clear bio
- Strong call-to-action
- Website or contact link

Optimizing your profile will raise the conversion rate from visitors to followers.

## Step 3: Create High-quality Reels Daily

Reels are the fastest-developing instrument on Instagram.

Best practices:

- Post 2-4 Reels daily
- Discuss popular subjects
- Use engaging hooks
- Keep videos concise
- Include captions and keywords

Regularly posting on Reels offers many advantages in terms of reach and discovery.

Explore our [social media marketing strategy](/blog/social-media-marketing-strategy) to align your Reels content with broader Instagram growth tactics.

## Step 4: Use an SMM Panel for Initial Social Proof

The most significant challenge for any new account is being seen as credible.

An SMM panel can assist:

- Enhance the initial number of followers
- Boost Reel views
- Improve post engagement
- Enhance profile credibility

Users are more inclined to follow accounts that are already active and popular. Read about [buying followers vs organic growth](/blog/buying-followers-vs-organic-growth) to strike the right balance.

Make sure to [choose the best SMM panel](/blog/how-to-choose-best-smm-panel) for Instagram growth services.

## Step 5: Focus on Reel Views First

Many new bloggers focus only on follower count. Instead, prioritize visibility.

Implement SMM services strategically for:

- Reel views
- Video reach
- Content discovery

More views can make your videos more appealing to organic viewers and lead them to watch and interact with your clips.

## Step 6: Post Consistently for 60 Days

Consistency is one of the most crucial growth factors.

Suggested schedule:

- 2-4 Reels daily
- 1 carousel post daily
- A variety of stories throughout the day
- Weekly engagement sessions

If you post regularly, your account is more likely to be favored by the Instagram algorithm.

Track your progress with our guide on how to [measure social media marketing performance](/blog/how-to-measure-social-media-marketing-performance) to see what’s working.

## Step 7: Engage with Trending Topics and Audio

Instagram is known for amplifying trending content.

Look for:

- Viral audio tracks
- Trending challenges
- Industry discussions
- Popular content formats

Trends + Niche = Discoverability.

Check out the latest [viral social media trends](/blog/viral-social-media-trends) to jump on what’s hot.

## Step 8: Use Hashtags and Keywords Strategically

Instagram search is getting more keyword-specific.

Include:

- Niche-specific hashtags
- Long-tail keywords
- Relevant captions
- Search-friendly descriptions

This will ensure that your content is visible in search results and suggestions.

## Step 9: Boost High-performing Content

Not all of your posts will “go viral.”

Identify:

- Best-performing Reels
- Most shared posts
- Highest engagement content

Properly using an SMM panel to boost already successful content is likely to be more effective than promoting weaker content. Avoid [common mistakes when using SMM panels](/blog/common-mistakes-when-using-smm-panels) when promoting your best content.

## Step 10: Engage With Your Target Audience

It’s not just about publishing content.

Daily engagement activities:

- Reply to comments
- Respond to DMs
- Comment on niche pages
- Interact with followers
- Participate in discussions

Engagement fosters community and trust. Discover how [social proof is a secret weapon for small businesses](/blog/social-proof-secret-weapon-small-businesses) on Instagram.

## Step 11: Collaborate with Small Creators

Partnerships can make a significant difference in growth.

Benefits include:

- Familiarity with new audiences
- Increased credibility
- Higher engagement rates
- Faster follower acquisition

Find creators in your niche with an audience as similar as possible to your target audience. Posts that are done jointly, in the form of Reels or shoutout posts, can lead to more engagement than individual posts.

Big influencers are not always the best to work with, as they often can be picky about their collaborations with micro-influencers and niche creators. Even if you are just collaborating with a few others, you can feature your account in thousands of new followers.

Partnering with consistent content and a strategic SMM panel support is a powerful growth system for a new Instagram account.

## Track Analytics and Adjust Strategy

The key to growth is continuous improvement.

Monitor:

- Reach
- Engagement rate
- Reel views
- Follower growth
- Profile visits
- Website clicks

Analytics aid in the discovery of which content is most engaging to your users. If there is a particular subject that gets more hits than others, develop more content on that subject.

Don’t focus only on follower count. The quality of engagement and the performance of the content can be more telling of long-term success. Weekly analytics can help you adjust your approach and fine-tune your strategy for better growth over the 60 days.

Learn to [spot a fake Instagram account](/blog/how-to-spot-a-fake-instagram-account) so you can identify genuine engagement from bots.

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

Many users face issues due to unnecessary mistakes.

Common errors include:

- Posting inconsistently
- Buying a large number of followers suddenly
- Ignoring content quality
- Using irrelevant hashtags
- Copying competitors completely
- Neglecting audience engagement

An SMM panel aims to support growth and not to act as a substitute for real marketing. Numbers-only accounts tend to have poor engagement and are unlikely to have long-term success. Read about [how to identify and avoid SMM panel scams](/blog/identify-and-avoid-scams-when-buying-smm-panel-services) to ensure you’re using legitimate services.

The top Instagram content creators have mastered the art of sustainable growth, leveraging the power of social proof, content quality, audience engagement, and strategic promotion.

## Conclusion

In 60 days, you can get an Instagram account from 0 to 10K followers with a combination of quality content, promotional tools, and smart strategy. The key to success is creating quality content, posting regularly, engaging with the audience, and having good visibility tactics. An [SMM panel](/) can generate initial momentum by improving social proof and content visibility, but ultimately, it’s about delivering value to followers for sustained growth. SMM panels can aid new accounts achieve a competitive existence in their niche and can assist with quicker Instagram development when used together with a powerful content material strategy.

Hopefully, you understood How to Grow a Brand New Instagram Account from 0 to 10K in 60 Days Using SMM Panel!
